description: Rename a single node by ID. Returns the updated node with its new name. Use batch_rename_nodes to rename multiple nodes at once or to apply find/replace patterns across many nodes.

name.description: New name for the node. Figma supports slash-separated path notation e.g. 'Icons/Arrow/Left' to organise nodes in component panels.

nodeId.description: Node ID in colon format e.g. '4029:12345'

name: rename_node
